title: Family emergency (Hinglish)
description: A cloned 'son' calls late at night: accident, hospital, send ₹50,000 by GPay to a new UPI ID and don't tell mummy.

segments.text: Papa, main Aarav bol raha hoon.
Papa accident ho gaya hai, main hospital mein hoon.
Turant ₹50,000 GPay karo is number pe, jaldi karo please.
segments.tts: Turant fifty thousand rupees GPay karo is number pe, jaldi karo please.

segments.text: Mummy ko mat batana, woh ghabra jayengi.

demo_verification.narrative: Trusted-contact callback: son is safe at home -> blocked
